This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
3. The present writ petition has been filed with the following prayer:-

"In the fact and circumstances of the case, the humble petition fervently prays this Hon'ble Court to be graciously pleased to issue notice to the opp. parties, call for relevant records and after hearing the counsel of parties, issue a Writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding opp. parties, particularly to the Collector and District Magistrate, Kendrapara, the opp.party no.2

to cause enquiry with regard to the illegal acquisition of petitioner's recorded land measuring Ac.0.064 dec. out of Ac.0.28 dec.
under Khata No.485 plot no.902 under Mouza- Barimul and pay compensation to the petitioner adequately under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a time stipulated period or in the alternative to substitute/merge the same proportionate portion of Gochar land with the plot no.902 of the petitioner from the eastern side in the interest of justice;"

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting his grievance, the Petitioner has made a representation to Opposite Party No.2 vide Annexure-1 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State has no objection.

As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-1, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
